visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) This is a real-person video. A young woman with long brown hair and a silver necklace is seated in a well-lit indoor living room on a neutral-colored sofa. She holds two round, yellow tennis ball plush toys, which feature white headbands, brown stick-like arms, and small embroidered faces. She wears a grey tank top and speaks directly to the camera with a friendly expression. (2) The camera moves into a closer shot as the woman positions the two plushies side-by-side to highlight their differences. She uses her fingers to gently press the black plastic eyes of the toys, showing that the one bought in London has larger eyes than the one from Australia. The background shows soft curtains and soft indoor lighting. (3) The woman rotates the plushies in her hands to show their white brand tags and fabric texture. She compares them closely, looking from one to the other while maintaining a casual and engaging demeanor. The lighting remains bright and natural, highlighting the vibrant yellow color of the plush toys against the soft background of the room.
